summary: Pearl Diver Credit Company Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 (Other Events) disclosing that management's unaudited net asset value per share of common stock was $10.67 as of September 30, 2026. The report, signed by CEO Indranil Basu and dated October 12, 2026, contains no transaction, no stake, no price per share, no premium, no advisor, and no board recommendation. There is no special-situation event, so the filing is classified as None on this taxonomy.
